_comment: Copy to the root of the target project as .swissknife.json — install.sh will read it automatically. All keys are optional. Priority: flags CLI > this file > autodetection.
_comment_project_type: obsidian-vault | laravel-project | php-package | standalone — is mapped to profiles/<type>.json
_comment_buckets: explicit list bucket-ov; if specified - project_type ignored
_comment_exclude: names of skills, folders or bucket-relative paths; merges with --exclude
_comment_skills_path: where to put relative to the project root; default depends on agent
_comment_agent: claude | cursor | generic; claude = flat layout
_comment_providers: Optional: the absence of a block saves legacy Claude Code-only behavior and nothing migrates.
